request: Ahri’s orb damages a stationary enemy repeatedly while passing through it. It should hit each enemy once going outward and once returning, regardless of simulation step size. Reproduce the issue and investigate what is causing it.
analysis: The collision loop checks m.hit.Contains(u), but line 215 clears that set on each collision and never adds the struck unit. This is a likely cause of repeated damage while successive swept segments overlap a stationary target. Line 228 separately clears the set at the outward-to-return transition, which supports allowing one hit per leg. The scenario tests outward and complete-flight damage at two step sizes, with an off-path control. No runtime failure has yet been observed.

reviewReason: The report explicitly requires one hit per enemy on each leg, independent of step size. Original Cast supplies 100 + 0.5*AP damage; zero AP and MR therefore justify 100 damage per leg without changing balance. Speed 11 and range 8 place the 0.5-second checkpoint after outward contact and before return contact; 1.6 seconds covers both legs. Initial conditions are established before casting. The trace reproduces excess damage and step dependence. Source clears hit history on every collision instead of recording the victim, allowing repeated overlap hits. These checks witness the reported case, not all enemies or all step sizes.
